beats.acceptance_criterion: AC-5: Error-state edge case — nonexistent route returns HTTP 404 deterministically
beats.expected_result: Server returns HTTP 404 Not Found without crashing

assertion.description: Missing route returns deterministic HTTP 404 status

beats.narration: Finally, let's check an error-state edge case by requesting a route that doesn't exist. The server responds cleanly with HTTP 404 and no unhandled exceptions, completing all five verification checks for this commit.
